title: Lower default search rate limit for /search/v2/search from 300 to 60 requests per minute

endpoints.before: Anonymous requests to POST /search/v2/search used the default RateLimitTier::Search limit of 300 requests per minute.
endpoints.after: Anonymous requests to POST /search/v2/search use the lowered default RateLimitTier::Search limit of 60 requests per minute (configurable via RATE_LIMIT_SEARCH_PER_MINUTE).
endpoints.clientAction: None for normal usage; high-frequency callers exceeding 60 requests per minute will receive 429 RATE_LIMITED.

endpoints.before: Anonymous requests to GET /search/v2/search used the default RateLimitTier::Search limit of 300 requests per minute.
endpoints.after: Anonymous requests to GET /search/v2/search use the lowered default RateLimitTier::Search limit of 60 requests per minute (configurable via RATE_LIMIT_SEARCH_PER_MINUTE).
endpoints.clientAction: None for normal usage; high-frequency callers exceeding 60 requests per minute will receive 429 RATE_LIMITED.
